title: Connecting Redux with React
overview: Redux can be integrated with React applications using the React Redux library, which provides tools to connect components with the Redux store.

example.title: Redux React Flow
example.content:
React Component
 ↓
React Redux
 ↓
Redux Store

title: Provider Component
overview: Provider makes the Redux store available to all React components in the application.

title: Connecting Components with Store
overview: React components access Redux state and dispatch actions using React Redux hooks.

title: Reading Redux State
overview: Components can read data from the Redux store using the useSelector hook.

title: Updating Redux State
overview: React components update Redux state by dispatching actions using useDispatch.

title: Redux Component Data Flow
overview: Redux creates a predictable flow between user actions, components, reducers, and the store.

example.title: Complete Flow
example.content:
User Click
 ↓
Component
 ↓
dispatch()
 ↓
Reducer
 ↓
Store
 ↓
UI Update

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Redux connects with React using Provider, useSelector, useDispatch, and predictable data flow.
